summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on recalculating historical analytics due to a new sensor installation in Lithuania (ID: 001E422ADCF3) that was added retroactively. To account for the previous two weeks, both 'do-calc' and 'do-aggregation' processes are required.

Regarding demographic data, [p1] provided resources for a commercial service with demographics via ArcGIS. It was noted that while free accounts offer limited queries, paid usage is priced per 1,000 variables. To limit costs, it was recommended to restrict analysis by specific geographic areas (e.g., ZIP codes) and select only necessary demographic variables (e.g., `KeyGlobalFacts.TOTPOP`).
decisions: The session data for the previous two weeks must be recalculated using 'do-calc' and 'do-aggregation'.
The model will be rerun by someone after [me] recalculates the sessions.
action_items: [me] to perform the session recalculation (do-calc/do-aggregation) by the next day.
[p1] to run the model using the newly calculated session data.
[p1] to investigate and potentially register for the ArcGIS demographic service access.
